main_body: Flat-roofed sandstone building: a sand terrace roof with a teal dome on top, above a brick front wall with an arched door and a small lattice window
top_band: Light sand roof surface, rows 2-33, speckled, with a lighter front-edge band at rows 30-33 and a dark edge line at row 34
evidence: Down a middle column the roof reads as a large horizontal sand surface (rows 2-33) with a dome standing on it. A lighter lip at rows 30-33 marks the front edge, then a dark brown shadow row at 34-35, then the brick front wall (rows 36-65) with its own mortar lines. The door has a pale frame and dark inner edge, and the window has a sill and inset lattice. The top is tall for a foreshortened surface but reads as a flat terrace roof, and the front face is clearly separate, so this is a valid 3/4 drawing.

style.evidence: The dome has about 5 teal steps and the sand roof has 4-5 tones with speckle. The bricks have 3-4 tones with mortar lines, and the door has grain, studs and bands. Outlines are dark brown tinted to the material, not black. Individual bricks and the dome base are somewhat flat, and tile density is a little below the references, but it is acceptable beside them.
